title: Howls from the Dark Ages: An Anthology of Medieval Horror
author: P.L. McMillan
review: There's some really good stuff in this short story collection. Really true to form medieval horror that exemplifies the genre. Evil priests, nuns, creepy castles and knights, horrible plagues, spooky forests; a lot of variety and some great themes as well, only a couple of stories that were just ok. Most were excellent and would like to read more from a few of these authors.
